android.desc:
Wield the music elements to play music in real time! 

Pick the track belonging to one of the proposed genres, and use your phone or bluetooth music wearable to play it.

Perfectly pairs with Music Wearables devices (see https://www.musdev.eu/).

Also supports autoplay and playing with finger taps.
Coming soon: play by moving your phone or Android watch. 

Visit the site https://www.musdev.eu/ and Youtube channel https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgcOxK6XFEyg6Bu6jBbU-Ag 
for info about Music Wearables.

quotes.text:
Dear community!

Long story short: I seek for prospective startup co-founders. My idea (and already working prototypes): use sensor-based wearabled to let people play music without any knowledge of skill.

You can view the product here: www.musdev.eu

I have spent >10 years creating various music-playing/music-generating games, including usage of smartphone/smartwatch sensors, i.e., I have big experience and even bigger dedication to the topic. Some of them are present at early videos on my Youtube channel:

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgcOxK6XFEyg6Bu6jBbU-Ag/

On this channel shorts demonstrate usage of the product (2+ self-made wearable devices) allowing for playing of the music tracks. Long videos mostly explain how it is done. 
The corresponding Android App:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Nature.CotE&hl=en-US&pli=1

implements some experimental algorithm for music creation from scratch, and is usable without additional devices.

Closer to the point: despite many people I talked to like the idea and like the prototypes, I realize it is A LOT of work to make an actual startup and a working business, and I just can not (and do not want to) make it alone. I am scientist, programmer + a bit musician + a bit engineer, my website-resume: https://kgubaev.eu/

Currently I seek for:

- Business Development Manager: somebody who knows how to launch a business, approach clients, work with investors, and what steps are needed to be done and when.

- Game …
quotes.title: Seeking co-founders: music tech startup
